title: Can't edit Map Properties : create a new empty map

posts.author: Volsung
posts.body:
Hi
Very weird bug here, whenever I edit anything in any map properties, like adding BGM or troops, when I click OK it creates a new empty map, and my edit in map properties got removed.
I tried a fresh install, a reboot, I removed RPG MAKER MZ whole registry, I deleted files in appdata, but the bug still remains.
The bug appears on empty project, with no plugin, with Stream fresh install.
I need help.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
what is the full path to your project, beginnig with the drive letter (usually c:\) and going to the project file?
Unless your entire windows is messed up, this might be an access problem (like you don't have the rights to edit files, only create new ones).
and those are usually folder dependent and often happen if the folder got stored in the wrong place.

posts.author: Volsung
posts.body:
I created a project at C:\test and the bug still happens.
I can edit and save json files manually, I can edit the Database in MZ, only Map Properties is causing this.
EDIT:
OK nvm it was stupid. I tried to open Map properties by pressing Enter, but instead of editing it opens the map properties window to create a new map.... I have to press Space instead, or right clic.
